notes.title: v1.5.4 is out!
notes.content:
Sorry for the silence and the lack of updates lately, I’ve been away for a bit due to a personal event, but I’m back with a new release!

Also, I'm excited to share that I have started the development of a brand new game! Unfortunately this means I'll spend a bit less time on this game for the coming months, but don't worry I'm not abandoning it and will continue to improve it.

Additions:
- add Dual Blessing item

Modifications:
- improve Russian translation (thanks to katsune)
- redesign dialog boxes
- you can now reroll items in first rooms
- add tooltips on boss marks
- now remember the last item position when using the Well of Oblivion
- reduce a bit the max gems and vampire bats spawn rate

Bugfixes:
- the laser sound was sometimes too loud
- the MechaBanker boss was not appearing in endless mode
- Virus was not fully working on enemies that use squirrels, poison puddles or fire arrows

notes.title: v1.5.2 is out!
notes.content:
Additions:
- add the Bribe item
- add King’s outfit items (armor, shield and helmet)

Improvements:
- improve the korean translation (thanks to 마술토깽이)
- If you have empty the legendary item pool, get rare items instead of potions
- improve performances of flames
- improve the Summoner description

Bugfixes:
- the SuperReroll item wasn't working on Blood Donation and Forge rooms

notes.title: v1.5.0 is out!
notes.content:
As usual, here is a new update with several additions and modifications!
This version has some majors technical changes, so if you see any issues please do not hesitate to report them (either in the Steam discussions or in the Discord server).

I hope you'll like it, and if you do please leave a review :)

Additions:
- new Cursed Sword item
- new Vampire Bat item
- new Pottery Apprentice item
- new Overdraft Authorization item
- new Second-Hand Shoes item
- support of plenty of new languages (in beta state)

Modifications:
- improved performances and stability
- with a keyboard, can use E instead of Enter to simplify the use of the game with a mouse
- the Hacker can now choose between hacking and using machines normally
- get a free starting chest when playing in easy mode
- antimatter cannot be find anymore with Summoner/BomberKid
- the Vampire now has Vampire Bat item by default
- the Knight boss now moves slower
- more items and less enemies HP in multiplayer mode
- the Condemned/Dead/Cultist characters now have dedicated weapon sprites (thanks to @Joethezombie)

Bugfixes:
- some damages texts were not displayed
- some boss patterns were broken and really hard to dodge
- it was possible to quit and resume the run to have another item
- the Pyro/Knight/Summoner characters weren’t able to throw magic crystals

notes.title: v1.4.0 is out!
notes.content:
Additions:
- new alternative boss to the Villain
- new Conqueror's Crown item

Modifications:
- rework Destroyer-related challenges description to make them more obvious
- increase a bit the speed of Little Wisp
- improve Black Hole behavior on enemies
- bombing bank now fill hearts to all players
- no more offering rooms after bombing the offering statue
- explicit Summoner behavior
- reduce a bit the Nail Bomb damages
- Extra Hand will now always autofire with Bomber Kid

Bugfixes:
- fix motion issue with Circular Saw Blades + Wave + Twin Shot
- now can use keyboard even if controller connected

notes.title: v1.3.2 and -60% during winter sales!
notes.content:
There is still few days before the end of the winter sales, so there is still time to tell you friends and family to get the game!

Changelog:
- add Nail Bomb item
- add music/sounds volume sliders in settings
- always give a Fake Bank Card when bombing the redraw machine
- the Super Redraw item was not working on item room
- the Rebound item does not appears anymore for characters without weapons

notes.title: v1.3.1 is out with Steam Achievements support!
notes.content:
It was a long-awaited request that is finally implemented in this version.

Additions:
- Steam Achievements support

Improvements:
- Goblins with rotating bullets does not camp in the middle anymore

Bugfixes:
- Fix a possible issue with difficulty selection

notes.title: v1.3.0 is out with a big new challenge and unlockable character!
notes.content:
Here is time for a new big update! Do you find the game too easy? Then try to beat the new hidden boss!

Additions:
- new hidden boss with a great reward
- new unlockable character
- add the Fake Bank Card item
- add the Laser Turret item
- add the Rebound item

Improvements:
- the last challenge is now quicker to achieve, but harder
- there is now a color indicator for item rarity
- enemy’s poison and flames disappear on enemy’s death
- bigger main menu’s buttons (for touch screens)
- improve the patterns of some first floor’s bosses
- limit the number of allied skeletons to 30
- Circular Saw Blades now give +20% damage
- there is a chance to drop Fake Bank Card when bombing a redraw machine
- the Mix item is back as possible reward of the item room
- put back previous boss mark icons
- limit the number of simultaneous magic crystals
- Big Battery item is now a normal item (was rare before)
- Illusion item is now a rare item (was legendary before)
- Freezing Wind is now a rare item (was normal before)

Bugfixes:
- do not reset all settings when resetting progression
- may fix a possible crash after boss death
- Cyborg now can find Twin Projectiles or Triple Shot

notes.title: v1.2.7 is out!
notes.content:
Additions:
- add Extra Hand item

Improvements:
- Twin Projectiles and Triple Shot now have synergy
- you can now break barrels with a dash
- barrels now can sometimes give you coins
- the Offering room now offers two choices
- there is now less chances to find useless items at the beginning of a run
- Little Wisp now stays closer to the player
- Sacred Shield now works on blood donation machines
- the Redraw and Magic Key items now need only 5 charges
- rechargeable items now also recharge on room without enemies
- the Hacker has more chances to hack a machine
- the Mix item is moved to the rare item pool
- enemy bombs are now differentiated
- the introduction has been reworked
- increase Scythes rotation speed
- Black Hole and Conversion Ring now can be found in the common item pool

notes.title: v1.2.4 is out (with mouse support)!

Additions:
- Add mouse support
- The progress is now displayed on the home screen

Modifications:
- Improve English translation (thanks to AceSpinVader)
- The Pyromaniac cannot trigger DoT anymore with his flamethrower
- The Frog inherits the bomb improvements of its owner
- Improve the behavior of Twin Projectiles with some weapons

- Lightnings and Antimatter didn't work correctly

notes.title: v1.2.3 is out!
notes.content:
This release was possible thanks to all the great feedbacks from Joe_The_Zombie who took a lot of time testing the game, doing suggestions and recording a tutorial on Youtube (I encourage you to see it!).

Additions:
- add the Joja Cola item

Modifications:
- improve the english translations (thanks to AceSpinVader)
- the 20 bombs/keys items has been reduce to 10 bombs/keys
- boost the Scythes damage
- there is more time to dodge rocket attacks
- the Virus item now triggers on critical hits

- blood donation machine cannot gives the Sandwitch item anymore

notes.title: Version 0.5.1 is out
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Here is a small release bringing few fixes and changes:
- fix: on some Windows computers, the game was totally black
- fix: the Condamned character was sometimes locked again after the 0.5.0 update
- fix: enemies spawn by the final boss added in 0.5.0 were not automatically shooted
- feature: the orbital projectiles now go through walls and barrels and are more efficient now
- balance: the Ghost item needs more time to recharge

However, there is a big underlying technical change and having feedbacks would be great! Does it start correctly for you? Does it display correctly? Are the performances impacted?

notes.title: The 0.5.0 "Welcome to hell" update is out! (with a 40% discount)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm glad to announce a new release which brings quite a lot of content with notably a new hellish floor to discover.

But before describing the changes, please note that there is a 40% discount during Steam Autumn Sales! It is a good time to test the game if you didn't already.

New content:

 A new floor to discover, with another final boss and an alternative ending.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/e2d1cf9d32b1d0ff535b73b82f2794950ccb3b46.png
 A new character to unlock: The Chaos Cultist. For people who like to be surprised.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/f847a8c1ad51617e5449d99c55dae9d5fa436f5f.png
 There is now a way to become a ghost without being really dead
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/7288d3e23a6f47055c6bd038634f5a3e8c36df29.png
 A new item: The Assistance Drone. It provides a moving boost area.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/ec1a5f4e5c2033c5bd49ed1be7cb42dd8e32e895.png
 Rooms can now have some obstacles like barrels or crates
 The Burning Arrows now let a flame trail behind them.


Quality of life:

 The player now emit a small light, improving readability (especially in multiplayer)
 Global performances improvement (especially with the Energy Balls)
 The secrets and pause menu now display the activable item types
 MULTIPLAYER: ghosts can now dash
 Small improvements of dialogs with NPCs/Signs.


Balancing:

 The difficulty level now also impact the number of enemies
 The Gift item is nerfed a bit since it now can also gives 50 souls
 The Midas's Hand has been nerfed and is now usable once per room
 The Pestilence boss has been sightly simplified


Bugfixes:

 Sacred Shield were not always protecting you
 Bosses were sometimes acting weird just after starting a new phase
 You were able to die even with some remaining fake hearts

notes.title: 0.2.0 released!
notes.content:
Here comes a little update that brings bugfixes, performance improvements with some bosses and also add fews features or improvements:

 There is now a new room called "Laboratory" which allows you to get potions and only that in exchange of keys or bombs. A simple way to be more powerful.
 Activable and Single-use items are now clearly differentiated with a different color and label. 
 Shockwaves are now a bit less visible, allowing you to better focus on the enemies.


I hope you'll like this, and expect new content to come later!
